caption: Bastione di Saint Remy, Cagliari
composition: Neoclassical bastion arch at pre-dawn · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera faces the Bastione di Saint Remy from the square below in the last dark minutes before dawn. The floodlit triumphal arch stands at the center-right, its twin staircases sweeping down toward the viewer, while the long balustraded terrace runs leftward behind it. The modelled 23 September 2026, 06:00 sky is still deep blue with drifting cloud, and the warm lights pool on the rain-slick paving stones of the empty piazza.
